usda.title: Cook to a Safe Minimum Internal Temperature: Safe Minimum Internal Temperature Chart for Cooking
usda.rest_note: Rest time is important for certain meats because it allows the innermost parts and juices of the meats to become fully and safely cooked.

checkoff.title: Determining Doneness
checkoff.text: For medium-rare the temperature should read 145°F and allow to rest for at least three minutes. For medium steaks the temperature should read 160°F, and well done is 170°F. Ground Beef should be cooked to a safe and savory 160ºF. Color is not a reliable indicator of Ground Beef doneness.

atk.title: Doneness Temperatures for Beef and Lamb

placement.title: Do You Know the Correct Place to Insert Your Food Thermometer?
points: thickest part, away from bone and gristle
thin foods such as sausage patties: from the side until it reaches the center
remove the food from the heat before taking its temperature
